CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

Repository Overview

This is improveR, the R client package for Scinteco’s improve platform - a secure, versioned repository for pharmaceutical R&D data science and modeling workflows. The package provides 21 CFR Part 11 compliant workflow management for pharmaceutical modeling (NONMEM, MATLAB, Monolix), biostatistical analysis, and data science processes.

Core Architecture

Package Structure

  • R/: Core package functions organized by functional area
  • tests/testthat/: Comprehensive test suite using testthat framework
  • man/: Auto-generated documentation from roxygen2 comments
  • vignettes/: Package documentation and tutorials
  • inst/: Package installation files and resources

Key Functional Areas

Authentication & Connection - improveConnect(): OAuth-based authentication with token management - oauthLogin.R, tokenManagement.R: Handle secure authentication flows - authenticatedREST.R: Authenticated API communication

Resource Management - loadResource.R: Load analytical resources with metadata and lineage tracking - getData.R, getR.R, getHTML.R, getGraphics.R: Retrieve different resource types - Resource relationship management via resourceRelations.R

Workflow Control - createWorkflow.R, createStepEnv.R: Create and manage pharmaceutical modeling workflows - runStep.R: Execute workflow steps - step.R: Core step functionality and management - importWorkflow.R, exportWorkflow.R: Workflow import/export capabilities

CLI Integration - cliClone.R, cliPush.R, cliPull.R: Git-like version control operations - cliSetup.R: CLI configuration and initialization

Review System - loadREview.R, reviewers.R, reviews.R: Team-based pharmaceutical research review workflows - reviewComments.R, reviewEntryComments.R: Comment and feedback management

Metadata & Compliance - metadata.R, getMetaData.R: Rich metadata handling for regulatory documentation - loadAuditTrail.R: Comprehensive tracking for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance - getLineage.R: Data lineage tracking

Development Commands

Testing

# Run all tests
devtools::test()

# Run specific test file
testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-initial.R")

# Check package
devtools::check()

Building and Documentation

# Build package
devtools::build()

# Install package locally
devtools::install()

# Generate documentation
devtools::document()

# Build website with pkgdown
pkgdown::build_site()

Package Management

# Load package for development
devtools::load_all()

# Check dependencies
devtools::check_dep_version()

Important Dependencies

The package relies heavily on: - httr: HTTP client for REST API communication - jsonlite: JSON parsing for API responses - jose: JWT token handling for OAuth - dplyr/tidyr: Data manipulation for pharmaceutical datasets - logging: Comprehensive logging for audit trails

Connecting to the improve Server

To execute improveR functions against a live improve server:

Prerequisites (User must do once per session)

  1. User authenticates via OAuth in their R console:

    library(improveR)
improveOAuth(
  repo = Sys.getenv("IMPROVER_REPO_URL"),  # from .Renviron
  shortEntityId = Sys.getenv("IMPROVER_STEP")
)

  2. User starts shared token refresh:

    library(improveRtestsupport)
secret <- startSharedTokenRefresh(verbose = TRUE)
cat("Secret:", secret, "\n")

  3. User provides the secret UUID to Claude

Claude Connection Process

  1. Update the secret in .claude_workspace/helper.R

  2. Run R commands from package root using:

    Rscript -e "source('.claude_workspace/helper.R'); <your_code>"

  3. Helper provides:

    • claude_connect() - establishes connection using shared tokens
    • list_children(path) - lists child resources at a path

Notes

  • .claude_workspace/ is gitignored - local helper files only
  • Tokens auto-refresh via improveRtestsupport::startSharedTokenRefresh()
  • Server config is in .Renviron (IMPROVER_REPO_URL, IMPROVER_STEP)

Development Notes

  • This is a pharmaceutical R&D focused package requiring regulatory compliance
  • All API communications go through authenticated REST endpoints
  • Extensive metadata and audit trail functionality for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance
  • Token refresh mechanisms handle long-running pharmaceutical modeling workflows
  • Integration with external tools (NONMEM, MATLAB, Monolix) via workflow steps
  • Comprehensive test coverage including error handling and authentication flows
  • never change the format of the code
  • don’t reformat existing code
  • never add a reference to Claude Code in commit messages
  • when writing function documentation, do not add references to 21 CFR Part 11
